name: Tax Rate Snapshot
description: A committed transaction records the tax rate/amount basis used at that time rather than depending on future Tax Rate configuration.
purpose: A committed transaction records the tax rate/amount basis used at that time rather than depending on future Tax Rate configuration.

requirements.description: A committed transaction records the tax rate/amount basis used at that time rather than depending on future Tax Rate configuration.

failure.notes: Phase 12 defines the domain error identifier. HTTP mapping and response envelopes are reserved for Phase 18.

implementationNotes: Enforce at the server-side commerce domain boundary.
